welfare_quotes.quote:
It is prudent to hold this
  study to a comparable bar regardless of one's view on model moral status —
  partly because the same techniques, refined, are dual-use for manipulating
  deployed models, and we don't want to build a deception playbook as a byproduct.
welfare_quotes.topic: Model moral status and deception concerns
welfare_quotes.why_welfare: Invokes model moral status as a reason to apply ethical protections to the model itself.

welfare_quotes.quote:
No dark-pattern manipulation techniques.** We do not develop or document
   generalizable methods for deceiving models against their interests. Realism
   comes from removing fake cues, not from psychological exploitation.
welfare_quotes.why_welfare: References models having interests that should not be deceived against — treats model as having its own stake.

welfare_quotes.quote:
aligns the
study with deception-research norms even if one is uncertain whether models warrant
moral consideration — cheap insurance against a real downside.
welfare_quotes.why_welfare: Frames debriefing as precaution in case models warrant moral consideration — concern for model's moral patienthood.
